turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is the Japan rail pass still worth it? I heard the price went up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It did go up quite a lot. It's worth it now mainly if you're doing several long bullet train trips in a short time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A recruiter is calling me tomorrow, and I already have an offer from somewhere else.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a strong position. Do you want to tell her about the other offer, or keep it to yourself for now?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: So my mum just texted and— look, this is important.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me a moment, Moshi, I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.text: I'm done pretending I like jazz.

turns.text: Emma, look at the fish tank. Does the water look cloudy to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little, yeah. When did you last change it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe three weeks ago? I kind of lost track.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's probably it. Do a partial change this weekend and go easy on the food.

turns.text: Do you still have that siphon thing?

turns.text: It's under my sink, I'll bring it over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All done with my mum. You can talk now, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We'd stopped at whether to mention the competing offer. Made up your mind?
